channel.title: Ministry of Victory · Major Orders
channel.description: Helldivers 2 Major Orders: when a new one starts and how each one ended, with the Ministry's forecast.

item.title: New Major Order: Hold the designated planets in order to enable the Firebreak Protocol, to raze infested…
item.description: Hold the designated planets in order to enable the Firebreak Protocol, to raze infested planets and stop the spread of the mutated Terminid strain. Our first call: Needs a record.

New Major Order: Defend against the required number of Terminid attacks in order to contain the…
item.description: Defend against the required number of Terminid attacks in order to contain the unprovoked, unforeseeable outbreak affecting multiple TCS+ sectors.

item.title: New Major Order: STRATEGIC THREAT
item.description: Investigate and, if warranted, hold the designated planets, in order to verify highly unlikely reports of TCS+ breaches. Our first call: Needs a push.

item.title: New Major Order: Eliminate the mandated number of Terminids in order to restore public confidence, quell…
item.description: Eliminate the mandated number of Terminids in order to restore public confidence, quell unlawful rumours of TCS+ failures, and safeguard Federal prosperity. Our first call: On track.

item.description: Acquire Automaton samples and kill Cyborgs to aid the development of enhanced digital interrogation techniques. Our first call: Out of reach.
